rationale: 2025 neonatal follow-up tests facial reactions to kale/carrot odors in infants whose mothers received prenatal powder capsules. Pinky’s exact-trail note links this report to the same maternal/fetal cohort family as the earlier report; do not count it as independent replication. Maternal capsule exposure is not roasted kale, and infant hedonic odor responses are not olfactory impairment or Parkinson disease. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39892645/

2022 study tests fetal facial reactions after maternal encapsulated kale or carrot powder. This is fetal flavor-response context, not roasted kale intervention or olfactory impairment; it is the earlier fetal result in the linked family followed up by PMID 39892645, not a second independent cohort. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36130610/
